## Description

Briefly describe the change and its rationale.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] Accessibility enhancement (WCAG compliance improvement)
- [ ] Documentation update (fixing typos, updating links)
- [ ] Performance optimization

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with 0 errors
- [ ] `npm run verify:comments` passes with exactly 0 comment nodes in source files
- [ ] `npm test` passes all unit and integration tests
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds without errors
- [ ] No personal or sensitive information has been added
